1.5.0: NewHubEvent: add an 'Output Type' option (First record / All records at once / One record at a time) and route the output through the shared lib helpers (sendArrayOutput / getOutputPortOptions). In the 'One record at a time' and 'First record' modes the individual hub fields are now exposed directly on the output port instead of being nested under the 'result' array. Loading the hub fields for the output port options is now fault-tolerant: if the TargetFields lookup fails, the generic record options are still offered instead of the option list ending up empty. BREAKING: the standalone 'conversionKey' output field was removed; events are already filtered to the configured hub.
1.4.1: StartHubWithData: fix bulk array input being collapsed into a single record. When a whole array is mapped from a previous step, Appmixer may serialize it into an object keyed by index ("0", "1", "2", ...); the component now restores it to an array so all records are sent to the hub.

NewHubEvent: fix webhook payload carrying an array of records being spread into an object with numeric keys ("0", "1", "2", ...) on the output. The trigger now exposes the records as an array under 'result' (with a 'count'), preserving a bulk batch as an array. BREAKING: the output shape changed from flat per-field columns to 'conversionKey' + 'result' array, so existing flows reading fields directly must remap them under 'result'.
1.4.0: StartHubWithData: support sending multiple records (bulk) in a single request. A 'Records source' switch lets you either build rows manually using the hub's dynamic source fields (repeating 'Records' field) or map a whole array of records from a previous step ('Records array'). The request body is sent as a JSON array either way. BREAKING: the input shape changed from flat per-field inputs to the new records inputs, so existing flows must remap their fields. Output now also returns the records count.
1.3.0: Map .NET field types (Int32, Int64, Double, Decimal, DateTime, Date, Guid, Boolean, ...) to matching Appmixer inspector input types and JSON schema types in StartHubWithData inputs and NewHubEvent output port options.
1.2.0: Replace removed HubsList endpoint with three dedicated list helpers: ListSourceHubsWithoutPostData (used by StartHub), ListSourceHubsWithPostData (used by StartHubWithData), and ListTargetHubs (used by NewHubEvent).
Auth: use ListTargetHubs endpoint for profile/validate checks (HubsList endpoint was removed).
1.1.1: NewHubEvent: load output port fields from TargetFields endpoint instead of SourceFields.
1.1.0: Add dynamic source field inputs to StartHubWithData based on selected hub.
Mark ListHubs, GetSourceFields, GetTargetFields as private helper components.
StartHubWithData returns conversionKey on success (fire-and-forget async action).
